Level 9 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: None
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Trade

A Bastion can have more than one Stable. Each comes with one Riding Horse or Camel and two Ponies or Mules, looked after by the hireling. It can house three Large animals; two Medium creatures take the space of one Large creature. After a Beast that can serve as a mount spends at least 14 days here, Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks made with respect to it have Advantage.

Trade: Animals. The hireling buys or sells one or more mounts at normal cost in 7 days, keeping those you buy in your Stable. The DM decides which animals are for sale (horses, ponies, and mules are the most common); you pay for all purchases. When you sell a mount from your Stable, the buyer pays 20 percent more than the standard price (50 percent at level 13, 100 percent at level 17).

Enlarging the Facility. For 2,000 GP, your Stable becomes Vast and can house six Large animals.
